eligibility_evidence: This is a highly visible global leadership role, responsible for shaping cloud architecture, operations, governance, and platform modernisation across a complex international technology landscape.
Lead the evolution of a hybrid global and sovereign cloud operating model, balancing shared services with regulatory, security, and data requirements.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. You will also ensure cloud services meet the requirements of regulated and sovereign environments, supporting both operational excellence and compliance obligations.
